\pgfplotslegendfromname{legtstarccpoN}\\
\pgfplotslegendfromname{legtstarccpoM}
\caption{CCPO. Left: number of subgradient iterations $t^\star$ (cold start at the root) needed to reach the bound inferred by the GNN in a single forward pass. Right: wall-clock time of these $t^\star$ iterations (solid) versus one GNN bound call (dashed; graph construction and forward pass on one H100 GPU, evaluation of $L(\lambda)$ on the same 24 CPU cores as the subgradient, TorchScript warm-up excluded). Medians over the 10 instances of each $(n, N)$. The subgradient is capped at 1\,000\,iterations or 3\,600\,s per instance; 9 instances do not reach the GNN bound within this budget and count as $+\infty$ in the medians.}
\label{fig:tstar_ccpo}
\end{figure}
